value.text: We haven't built ICS on grand buildings or prestige. Our money and energy go into good teaching and real relationships with students. That's how our results stay strong while our fees stay modest.

value.quote: “My daughter's found close friends through her Pastoral Care group, and I've built real friendships through our year-level Facebook group and Friday assemblies each week.”

image.alt: Three primary students laughing as they play together

value.text:
ICS has strong HSC results and a genuinely Christian culture, and its fees are well below most independent schools in the region. Every staff member is a Christian and every student is known by name.

Children learn in different ways. Our learning support teams for K-6 and 7-12 work with individual students and small groups, and in Years 7 to 10 there are smaller English and Maths classes for students who need extra help. Students who need more challenge are extended through LogICS (Learning Opportunities for Growth at ICS), our enrichment program, which is led by our Director of Student Learning Opportunities.

We also have a sensory room. For HSC students who are eligible, we apply to NESA for disability provisions.

Yes. We have learning support teams for K-6 and 7-12 and smaller literacy and numeracy classes in Years 7 to 10. Our psychologist and occupational therapist work on site. We'll talk with you about your child's needs before they start.

value.lead: Faith isn't a subject at ICS. You'll see it in how teachers greet your child in the morning and how students are taught to treat each other.
